questions.question: What does the Chain of a Thousand Miles have the ability to do?
questions.subject: Chain of a Thousand Miles

answer.item: keep extending endlessly as long as its user doesn't allow one of the ends of the chain to be seen

questions.question: What is the clip on the front end of the chain used for?
questions.subject: Chain of a Thousand Miles

answer.item: connect to other cursed tools in order to extend their range

questions.question: How did Toji use the chain in his second fight with Gojo?
questions.subject: Chain of a Thousand Miles

answer.item: Toji connected the chain to another one of his special grade cursed tools; the Inverted Spear of Heaven
